title: Work management context for AI agents with Smartsheet MCP on AWS
summary: The Smartsheet Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server lets AI agents read, update, and act on live work management data. This post shows two ways to connect it on AWS: Amazon Quick for business teams and Kiro for developers, so your agents can work with Smartsheet without switching
reason: Item is a technical how-to showing how to connect the Smartsheet MCP Server on AWS, not a new model release, research result, policy action, or announced open-source tool. Rule 5-1 requires a new open-source tool/repo and openness is not established; no other rule covers it.
